{% autoescape off %}# DAIV

> {{ definition }}

DAIV runs on your own servers with Docker Compose or Docker Swarm. You choose the LLM provider, and every agent's commands run in a sandbox whose network you define. It is licensed Apache-2.0, with no per-seat pricing.

Label an issue `daiv` and DAIV posts a plan; once you approve it, DAIV opens a merge request with the change and works to make its pipeline pass. Mention `@daiv` on a merge request and it answers or pushes a fix. It also takes work from your editor over MCP, from scripts through the Jobs API and on a schedule, and its dashboard shows every session.

- Source: https://github.com/srtab/daiv
- License: Apache-2.0
- Documentation: {{ docs_url }}
